video_title: Ray calls him Tyrese Haliburger | Play It Back

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese on playing through injury in a crucial Game 7
quotes.excerpt: If I had sat, that would have been weak.

text_blocks.speaker: Rayasianboy
text_blocks.text: If time goes back, Game 7, but you know you're gonna tear your shit. Would you still play?

text_blocks.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
text_blocks.text: Sure, we had a chance.

text_blocks.speaker: Rayasianboy
text_blocks.text: You think so? You'll still play? Even if you know you're gonna fuck up, you'll still play?

text_blocks.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
text_blocks.text: I knew going into the game there was a chance, so yeah, I wouldn't change it. If I had sat, that would have been weak.

quotes.speaker: Rayasianboy
quotes.excerpt: You're a bandwagon, bro. You gotta pick a team.

text_blocks.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
text_blocks.text: You're a bandwagon, bro. You gotta pick a team.

text_blocks.speaker: Rayasianboy
text_blocks.text: What's wrong with my team? I got Spurs, Thunder, and Boston.

text_blocks.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
text_blocks.text: So your teams are all the best teams.

text_blocks.speaker: Rayasianboy
text_blocks.text: That's not even bad. That's not even the best team. Spurs, Thunder, Boston. Yeah, that's my team. Because I'm a fan, I did a stream with Jaylen Brown. He's a close friend. Spurs, I just like Wembanyama.

text_blocks.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
text_blocks.text: So after this, you're gonna start saying you're a Pacers fan?

text_blocks.speaker: Rayasianboy
text_blocks.text: I don't know. I don't know about that.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese on learning to say no early in his career
quotes.excerpt: it's okay to say no to people. That's what I really struggled with early in my career

text_blocks.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
text_blocks.text: I would just say, dog, it's okay to say no to people. That's what I really struggled with early in my career, saying no to people because it's hard, especially when it's people you love, people that been there when you need them and stuff.

text_blocks.speaker: Rayasianboy
text_blocks.text: They've been telling you to get the water, be the water boy as a rookie, and you're scared to say no.

text_blocks.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
text_blocks.text: Those are just rookie duties. You gotta do that. Yeah, you gotta do that.

text_blocks.speaker: Rayasianboy
text_blocks.text: If you don't do that, if you try to be against them, they're gonna tell you, 'No, I don't want to do that.'

text_blocks.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
text_blocks.text: They're gonna pop your car, fill your car with chocolate or something.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese on the challenge of guarding Stephen Curry
quotes.excerpt: The thing with Steph is like, not like I start on him, but like other guys

text_blocks.speaker: Rayasianboy
text_blocks.text: Who's the hardest player you ever guarded?

text_blocks.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
text_blocks.text: Steph probably.

text_blocks.speaker: Rayasianboy
text_blocks.text: But you gotta run, you gotta run, you gotta run.

text_blocks.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
text_blocks.text: You gotta run, yeah. The thing with Steph is like, not like I start on him, but like other guys, you know like, if you guard a different guy, I don't gotta, if you guard Shai, I don't ever have to guard him because you're guarding him, you know what I mean?

quotes.speaker: Rayasianboy
quotes.summary_phrase: Rayasianboy blames interview for losing by 51 points
quotes.excerpt: I cannot focus on two things at one time, you feel me? I gotta choose one.

text_blocks.speaker: Rayasianboy
text_blocks.text: I wasn't trying. I was trying to interview you.

text_blocks.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
text_blocks.text: And I was answering the question.

text_blocks.speaker: Rayasianboy
text_blocks.text: They want me to bullshit. I cannot focus on two things at one time, you feel me? I gotta choose one. So I chose the interview. I wasn't playing for real.

text_blocks.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
text_blocks.text: You real for that.

text_blocks.speaker: Rayasianboy
text_blocks.text: I was lying.
